ame429.j.style.foot.en: Applied to the whole layout: writes opacity, background alpha and stroke width for every control; colors stay unchanged.

ame429.j.more.hint.en: Drag nodes to move; they snap to the 8pt grid on release. Drag a corner handle to scale uniformly. Use "Layers" to reorder and "Styles" to reskin the whole layout.
ame429.j.more.hint.zh-Hans: 拖动节点移动，松手自动吸附 8pt 网格；选中后拖角柄等比缩放；工具条「层」调整叠放次序，「样式」整版换肤。
ame429.j.more.hint.zh-CN: 拖动节点移动，松手自动吸附 8pt 网格；选中后拖角柄等比缩放；工具条「层」调整叠放次序，「样式」整版换肤。
ame429.j.more.hint.zh-Hant: 拖動節點移動，鬆手自動吸附 8pt 網格；選中後拖角柄等比縮放；工具條「層」調整疊放次序，「樣式」整版換膚。
